root_cause: NeMo MemoryTracker calls memory_summary without address, causing Ray auto-discovery to fail when several local clusters are active.
fix: Pass get_runtime_context().gcs_address to memory_summary so statistics query the cluster already connected to this driver.

coverage: Pristine tracker reproduces multiple-cluster discovery error.
Actual patched tracker advances from Preparation to Generation using the connected cluster.
Two independently selected job contexts use their own GCS addresses despite stale RAY_ADDRESS.
Current context is queried per snapshot, not cached.
Vendor patches apply twice from pristine pinned Git objects and reproduce actual files.

api_verification.verification: Wheel SHA256 verified against NeMo uv.lock; inspected ray/runtime_context.py and ray/_private/internal_api.py.
api_verification.context_property: RuntimeContext.gcs_address checks current worker connection and returns self.worker.gcs_client.address.

limitations: Tracker tests use simulated Ray boundary modules and real NeMo/Pydantic/psutil code; no full B200 training run.
